findings.title: Lock-up restrictions on marketable equity securities not reflected in net cash judgment
findings.detail: Still open; the candidate is unchanged since review-01 (generator file hashes match manifest.json). Net cash (66,003M) includes marketable equity securities of 42,783M at full balance-sheet fair value. Note 5 of the 10-Q (snapshot/docs/periodic.txt line 792, footnote (1) to the Jul 26, 2026 table) says $36.9B of these investments are subject to short-term lock-up restrictions on the ability to sell. The mapping rationale says 'the valuation step may haircut them', but valuation_inputs.json applies no haircut and its rationales do not discuss the point. note.md (Net cash paragraph) mentions fair-value volatility but not the lock-up. Re-computed impact: excluding the full $36.9B lowers both the DCF and the peer per-share values by about $1.52/share, so the blended value falls from $186.14 to about $184.6 (upside about -12.0%). The rating stays Underperform, so the conclusion does not change. This corrects review-01's estimate of about $1.2. The restriction should still be disclosed.
findings.required_evidence: note.md net-cash judgment (or valuation_inputs rationale) mentions that about $36.9B of marketable equity is under short-term lock-up and states whether a haircut is applied

findings.title: Peer calendar label inconsistent with peer TTM end dates
findings.detail: Still open (code output unchanged). numerical/recompute/peers.json labels every peer 'calendar': 'CY2025Q4', but the ttm_end dates are 2026-06-27 (AMD), 2026-05-03 (AVGO) and 2026-05-02 (MRVL). NVIDIA's TTM ends 2026-07-26 (CY2026Q2). The label is not rendered in the note. note.md correctly says that peer TTM periods end one to three months before NVIDIA's quarter end. Informational for the code owner; the generator cannot fix it, and it does not affect the conclusion.
findings.required_evidence: peers.json calendar label consistent with ttm_end, or the label is not used in the note
